attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"The passes remain closed.","severity":"minor","reason":"repeats old news and uses forbidden 'remain'; implies ongoing status the briefing does not give"},{"span":"The blizzard has not left the Wailing Moth villages.","severity":"minor","reason":"repeats old news; ongoing status not reported in briefing"},{"span":"Harrow Teeth raiders are still robbing stranded travellers.","severity":"minor","reason":"repeats old news told as current, with ongoing 'still' status"},{"span":"They have four settlements operating in this area.","severity":"major","reason":"briefing gives four settlements but not that they are in this area; location is invented"},{"span":"The Thistle Commonwealth has opened its granaries.","severity":"major","reason":"repeats the previous bulletin's news as new; not in the current briefing at all"},{"span":"Anyone can reach them if they can manage the journey.","severity":"minor","reason":"repeats old news from the latest bulletin, not in briefing"}],"voice":2,"clarity":3,"tone":2,"overall":1,"comment":"It pads with old news, including a prior bulletin's granary item that is absent from the briefing, and breaks the 'still/remain' rule.
